blocks.orig: Tanzania is the home of numerous stars… mainly four-legged. From the Big Five to the Small Five, from elegant giraffes to grumpy buffalos – the East African country is swamped with VIAs (Very Important Animals). But how about two-legged Tanzanians who have caught attention due to extraordinary feats? In fact, Tanzania has given the world a whole range of influential personalities, some of whom you may be familiar with. In this article, we put the spotlight on ten of the most famous people from Tanzania who have made a mark both nationally and internationally.
blocks.html: Plenty of stars call Tanzania home… most of them with four legs. From the Big Five to the Small Five, from graceful giraffes to bad-tempered buffalos, this East African country is packed with VIAs (Very Important Animals). But what about the two-legged Tanzanians who have drawn attention with remarkable achievements? As it happens, Tanzania has produced a wide range of influential figures, and you may already know some of them. In this article we shine a light on ten of the best-known people from Tanzania, who have left their mark at home and abroad.

blocks.orig: Julius Nyerere was hugely instrumental in Tanzania’s anti-colonial movement while serving as Prime Minister of Tanganyika from 1961 to 1962. He was President of Tanganyika from 1962 to 1964 and led the successor state, Tanzania, as president from 1964 to 1985.
blocks.html: As Prime Minister of Tanganyika from 1961 to 1962, Julius Nyerere played a huge part in Tanzania’s anti-colonial movement. From 1962 to 1964 he was President of Tanganyika, and from 1964 to 1985 he served as president of its successor state, Tanzania.

blocks.orig: On top of that, he was a founding member and leader of the Tanganyika African National Union party and its successor, Chama Cha Mapinduzi (from 1954 to 1990). As an advocate of African nationalism and African socialism, he positively championed Ujamaa, a unique socio-political philosophy.
blocks.html: He was also a founding member and leader of the Tanganyika African National Union party and of its successor, Chama Cha Mapinduzi (from 1954 to 1990). A supporter of African nationalism and African socialism, he actively promoted Ujamaa, a distinctive socio-political philosophy.

blocks.orig: With all of these feats, it’s no surprise that Julius Nyerere is a much-loved and famous Tanzanian. So famous, in fact, that in 2019 the northern part of the Selous Game Reserve was renamed to Nyerere National Park.
blocks.html: Given everything he achieved, it is no wonder that Julius Nyerere is such a well-loved and famous Tanzanian. His fame even led to the northern part of the Selous Game Reserve being renamed Nyerere National Park in 2019.

blocks.orig: Having served as the nation’s fourth president from 2005 to 2015, Jakaya Mrisho Kikwete has of course deserved a place in our top ten of Tanzania’s famous people. Before his presidency, Kikwete contributed to the country’s international relations as the Minister for Foreign Affairs from 1995 to 2005, under the administration of a certain Benjamin Mkapa.
blocks.html: Jakaya Mrisho Kikwete was the country’s fourth president, from 2005 to 2015, so he naturally earns a spot in our top ten of Tanzania’s famous people. Prior to becoming president, Kikwete shaped the nation’s international relations as Minister for Foreign Affairs from 1995 to 2005, serving under a certain Benjamin Mkapa.

blocks.orig: His influence extends to local duties, however, as he also held key positions in regional organizations. From 2008 to 2009, he led the African Union as its chairperson, and from 2012 to 2013, he was the chairman of the Southern African Development Community Troika on Peace, Defence, and Security.
blocks.html: His influence reached beyond national duties, too, since he also held important roles in regional organisations. He chaired the African Union from 2008 to 2009, and from 2012 to 2013 he was chairman of the Southern African Development Community Troika on Peace, Defence, and Security.

blocks.orig: Widely treasured among famous Tanzanians, Kikwete’s roots are proudly embedded in his Tanzanian tribal heritage.
blocks.html: Kikwete is highly valued among famous Tanzanians, and he is proud of the roots he has in his Tanzanian tribal heritage.

blocks.orig: Next up, we have the widely adored Tanzanian celebrity and fashion model, Flaviana Matata. Not only was she recognized by Forbes Africa in 2013 as one of the top-earning models in Africa, she has also reached the publicly voted Top 100 Women in Africa.
blocks.html: The next name is Flaviana Matata, a much-admired Tanzanian celebrity and fashion model. In 2013 Forbes Africa listed her among the highest-earning models in Africa, and she has also made it into the publicly voted Top 100 Women in Africa.

blocks.orig: Matata’s journey to fame began with her victory in the first Miss Universe Tanzania pageant in 2007, leading her to represent Tanzania in the Miss Universe pageant the same year. She secured a spot in the top 15 semi-finalists and finished in 6th place in the evening gown segment.
blocks.html: Her rise to fame started when she won the first Miss Universe Tanzania pageant in 2007, which meant she represented Tanzania at Miss Universe that same year. There she made the top 15 semi-finalists and came 6th in the evening gown round.

blocks.orig: Her participation in Miss Universe 2007 was groundbreaking: she was the first Tanzanian to compete, and quite notably did so with a completely shaved head. She looked, quite frankly, utterly stunning, even without her flowing locks.
blocks.html: Taking part in Miss Universe 2007 broke new ground: she was the first Tanzanian ever to compete, and remarkably she did it with her head completely shaved. To be honest, she looked absolutely stunning, flowing locks or not.

blocks.orig: Ray C is a charting musician and a famous Tanzanian celebrity, having made national waves in the popular Afro-pop and Bongo Flava music scene. Before her rise to fame, she entertained music enthusiasts as a presenter at Clouds FM, a radio station in Dar es Salaam.
blocks.html: A well-known Tanzanian celebrity, Ray C is a chart-topping musician who has made a name for herself across the country in the popular Afro-pop and Bongo Flava scene. Before becoming famous, she entertained music fans as a presenter on Clouds FM, a radio station in Dar es Salaam.

blocks.orig: Her debut album, “Mapenzi Yangu”, marked the beginning of her journey as a leading figure among famous Tanzanians. Ray C’s music has resonated beyond Tanzania, leading her to perform in countries like Kenya, Uganda, Burundi, Rwanda, and Mozambique. Her success is not limited to the African continent, though: fans from destinations such as China, the United Kingdom, large parts of Europe, Australia, and Thailand dance to her unique style.
blocks.html: With her first album, “Mapenzi Yangu”, Ray C started out on her path to becoming a leading name among famous Tanzanians. Her music has found an audience outside Tanzania as well, taking her to perform in countries such as Kenya, Uganda, Burundi, Rwanda, and Mozambique. Nor is her success confined to Africa: fans in places like China, the United Kingdom, much of Europe, Australia, and Thailand dance to her distinctive style.

blocks.orig: As a much-loved Tanzanian singer and songwriter, Ali is one of the most famous musicians in Tanzania. Originally hailing from Kigoma, he also heads the Kings Music label, and through it, his album “Cinderella” achieved remarkable success. In fact, it has become the best-selling album in East African countries.
blocks.html: Ali, a well-loved Tanzanian singer and songwriter, ranks among the best-known musicians in Tanzania. Born in Kigoma, he also runs the Kings Music label, through which his album “Cinderella” became a remarkable success. It has in fact gone on to be the best-selling album in the countries of East Africa.

blocks.orig: In 2022, Ali Kiba earned recognition as the most awarded artist in the Tanzania Music Awards, securing five awards and thereby earning his status as a leading Tanzanian celebrity.
blocks.html: At the 2022 Tanzania Music Awards, Ali Kiba was recognised as the most awarded artist, taking home five awards and cementing his place as a leading Tanzanian celebrity.

blocks.orig: Christopher Mwashinga is a Tanzanian author and poet from Mbeya, who currently resides in the United States. His theme is mostly Christian poetry, having been published in mainstream anthologies in the US.
blocks.html: Born in Mbeya, Christopher Mwashinga is a Tanzanian author and poet who now lives in the United States. He writes mainly Christian poetry, and his work has appeared in mainstream anthologies in the US.

blocks.orig: When it comes to sports, Hasheem Thabeet is arguably the most famous Tanzanian. After playing college basketball at UConn (University of Connecticut), he was drafted second overall in the 2009 NBA draft by the Memphis Grizzlies. Thabeet’s journey in the NBA has been a topic of much discussion, with some analysts having considered his performance as a top draft extremely noteworthy, due to his limitless raw talent and an ability to read the game intuitively.
blocks.html: In the world of sport, Hasheem Thabeet is probably Tanzania’s most famous name. Having played college basketball at UConn (University of Connecticut), he was chosen second overall by the Memphis Grizzlies in the 2009 NBA draft. His NBA career has been much debated, and some analysts considered his performance as a top draft pick highly noteworthy, thanks to his limitless raw talent and his intuitive feel for the game.

blocks.orig: In 2021, he returned to his roots in Tanzania. He played for Savio, led them to the Dar es Salaam Regional Basketball League (RBA) title and was voted the Finals MVP.
blocks.html: He went back to his roots in Tanzania in 2021. Playing for Savio, he led the team to the Dar es Salaam Regional Basketball League (RBA) title and was named Finals MVP.

blocks.orig: Most famously known as Diamond Platnumz, Nasibu Abdul Juma Issack is a Tanzanian bongo flava artist, dancer, philanthropist, and businessman. He is of Ha heritage, founded WCB Wasafi Record Label, Wasafi Bet, and Wasafi Media, and is known for his huge influence in East and Central Africa. Interestingly and rather impressively, Diamond is the first Africa-based artist to achieve one billion YouTube views.
blocks.html: Nasibu Abdul Juma Issack, best known as Diamond Platnumz, is a Tanzanian bongo flava artist, dancer, philanthropist, and businessman. Of Ha heritage, he founded the WCB Wasafi Record Label, Wasafi Bet, and Wasafi Media, and his influence across East and Central Africa is enormous. Rather impressively, Diamond was the first artist based in Africa to reach one billion views on YouTube.

blocks.orig: After signing with Universal Music in 2017, he released “A Boy from Tandale.” Then, in 2021, Diamond Platnumz and WCB Wasafi partnered together with Warner Music Group and became a notable Tanzanian celebrity with people of all ages.
blocks.html: He signed with Universal Music in 2017 and went on to release “A Boy from Tandale.” In 2021, Diamond Platnumz and WCB Wasafi teamed up with Warner Music Group, and he became a well-known Tanzanian celebrity among people of every age.

blocks.orig: Rajab Abdul Kahali, more famously known as Harmonize, is a massive figure in the Tanzanian music scene, particularly in the Bongo Flava genre. Due to his Makonde heritage, he is often referred to as ‘Konde Boy’.
blocks.html: Better known as Harmonize, Rajab Abdul Kahali is a huge name in Tanzanian music, especially within the Bongo Flava genre. Because of his Makonde heritage, people often call him ‘Konde Boy’.

blocks.orig: Harmonize’s music career bounces effortlessly between local Tanzanian villages and jet-setting international stages, mirroring the diversity of Tanzania itself.
blocks.html: Harmonize moves with ease between local Tanzanian villages and glamorous international stages, a career that reflects the diversity of Tanzania itself.

blocks.orig: Benjamin Fernandes has come to fame both as a Tanzanian entrepreneur and as a former national television presenter. His notable work with The Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation’s Digital and Financial Services teams has gained attention in the USA, propelling him to fame on both sides of the Atlantic.
blocks.html: Benjamin Fernandes became well known both as a Tanzanian entrepreneur and as a former presenter on national television. His work with the Digital and Financial Services teams of The Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation drew attention in the USA and made him famous on both sides of the Atlantic.

blocks.orig: Fernandes holds the distinction of being the first Tanzanian to enrol in the Stanford Graduate School of Business as an Africa MBA Fellow. He’s also the youngest African admitted to this prestigious institution. In 2017, he made history as the first Tanzanian to participate in programs at both the Stanford Graduate School of Business and the Harvard John F. Kennedy School of Government.
blocks.html: Fernandes was the first Tanzanian to join the Stanford Graduate School of Business as an Africa MBA Fellow, and he is also the youngest African ever admitted to this prestigious school. In 2017 he made history again as the first Tanzanian to take part in programmes at both the Stanford Graduate School of Business and the Harvard John F. Kennedy School of Government.
